snippet.title: Dune: Part Three - Official 'Tickets on Sale Now' Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the 'Tickets on Sale' Trailer for Dune: Part Three, the latest addition in the sci-fi film series distributed by Warner Bros. Witness the fallout of the reign of Emperor Paul Atreides in Dune: Part Three, in theaters on December 18.

Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Isaach De Bankolé, with Charlotte Rampling, with Anya Taylor-Joy, and Robert Pattinson, and Javier Bardem, and features newcomers Nakoa-Wolf Momoa and Ida Brooke.

Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As rebellion brews and enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

The film stars Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Isaach De Bankolé, with Charlotte Rampling, with Anya Taylor-Joy, and Robert Pattinson, and Javier Bardem, and features newcomers Nakoa-Wolf Momoa and Ida Brooke. Dune: Part Three is directed by Denis Villeneuve and written by Villeneuve and Brian K. Vaughan, based on the novel Dune Messiah by Frank Herbert, and delivers the epic conclusion to Villeneuve’s trilogy.

Dune: Part Three opens in theaters on December 18, 2026.

snippet.title: Skyrims Greatest Challenge - Starting From Zero
snippet.description:
What if you started from nothing in skyrim. A character with no health, no stamina, no magika. I mean people have done no magic runs of skyrim, no stamina walks and no hit runs but combining all of them together is crazy. 

Want a good drink? Checkout Holy here http://uk.holy.com/brit

BUT THEN IT GETS WORSE!!!! What if you also start with 0 for all skills and stats. (thankfully movement speed is only lowered to 70%). This means you start out with no carry weight and physically cannot do much moving or fighting. Effectively we are a twig that can do nothing but hope that they can leach some skills and stats off of the world. Our only advantage is as we defeat enemies we are given random skills so provided we spend enough time improving we too can become an unstoppable force in this game. 

So our goal is simple. Defeat Karstag the strongest enemy in the game. 
However ontop of this challenge we will also be playing on maximum difficulty legendary survival mode meaning we have to eat and sleep, we cannot fast travel and all enemies just got a lot more challenging. 

This video is a really special project I want to thank Nethalythic for making the stats on kill mod. I also want to shoutout @Joov for suggesting this challenge on legendary survival mode difficulty it was a blast! Of course our sponsors at holy have helped a bunch too! I hope you enjoyed watching it of course because this is a super special project with funny moments, bugs and exploits a plenty to entertain us on the journey to making an overpowered god character!
